Earnings of about $2 million on $8 million tangible assets demonstrated economic goodwill. → Economically, the business is a standout, generating pretax earnings of approximately $4-4.2 million on a stable sales base of $29-30 million [D02, D03, D09].

Growth in earnings required relatively little incremental operating capital. → Like a well-tended garden, the business requires little further capital to maintain its yield, allowing us to harvest the cash flow for other needs [D02, D08].
